data.message: The garage door opened while nobody is home.

conditions.value_template: {% set p = states.person.costea %}{{ p is not none and p.state not in ['home', 'unknown', 'unavailable'] and (as_timestamp(now()) - as_timestamp(p.last_changed)) >= 300 }}
{% set p = states.person.vio %}{{ p is not none and p.state not in ['home', 'unknown', 'unavailable'] and (as_timestamp(now()) - as_timestamp(p.last_changed)) >= 300 }}

description: HA-08. When the garage door starts opening from closed while person.costea and person.vio have both been away (known, not home) for at least 5 minutes, alerts both phones with a Close button. Never moves the door.
